title: Disable Kernel Modules
description: Disables specified kernel modules on managed Linux hosts by unloading them (if loaded) and adding install and blacklist directives to configuration files under /etc/modprobe.d/. Processes a comma-separated list of module names.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the Linux target to SSH into.

parameters.name: module_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of kernel module names to disable.

playbook_output.description: Structured result containing per-module status and overall success flag.

fields.name: all_succeeded
fields.description: True if every module was processed without any error.

fields.name: modules
fields.description: List of objects, each with keys: name (string), status (success/failure), actions (list of strings describing actions taken), error (string; empty if success).

steps.name: Parse input module list
steps.function: Convert the comma-separated module_list parameter into a list and a space-separated string for shell loop usage.

steps.name: Remediate kernel modules
steps.function: Process each module in the list: unload if loaded, ensure install directive to /bin/false, ensure blacklist, and output per-module result lines for later parsing.

steps.name: Parse per-module results
steps.function: Convert the stdout lines from the remediation script into a structured list of per-module results and derive an overall success flag.

computations._module_results: Parse each line of _remediation_result.stdout_lines, which are space-separated key=value entries in the form 'module:<name> status:<success/failure> actions:<comma,sep,actions> error:<string>'. For each line, extract name, status (keep as string), split actions by comma into a list (empty if none), and error (empty string if none). Build a list of dicts with these fields.
computations._all_succeeded: True if no entry in _module_results has status equal to 'failure', false otherwise.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the structured result containing per-module status and overall success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block if any step fails fatally. Prints error and fails the play.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Apply module disabling actions on the target host.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Interpret the script output into a structured result.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Deliver the final per-module status report.
